mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive in periods of FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.5% indicates a deteriorating labor market, which signals weak consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth is robust (PAYEMS above 130,000) and unemployment remains elevated (UNRATE above 8.0%), it reflects a labor market expanding despite high joblessness, indicating economic resilience and positive equity returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: labor market expansion with high unemployment
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 130000 and UNRATE > 8.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime where unemployment exceeds 8.0% and payroll employment surpasses 130,000, the S&P 500 exhibits positive returns over 60 days due to the perception of a strengthening labor market amid high joblessness.
regime_hint: labor market expansion with high unemployment
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0 and PAYEMS > 130000.

mechanism_narrative: High residential construction activity (HOUST above 600) reflects strong housing demand, which is a leading indicator of overall economic health and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when HOUST > 600 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 90.0 signals a manufacturing slowdown, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 90.0.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly high residential construction (HOUST > 600) and strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 380000) indicate robust demand across housing and consumption sectors, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when HOUST > 600 and RSAFS > 380000.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high industrial production (INDPRO > 95.0) and strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 13200), the S&P 500 experiences positive returns over 60 days due to sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO > 95.0 and GDPC1 > 13200.
